alloy.preparation: Pure 99.99% Al specimens; annealed for 2 h at 600 °C and water quenched. Coupons 10 × 30 mm cut from 1 mm cold-rolled sheet; edges and surface covered with cured epoxy leaving about 1 cm². Electropolished in HClO4/acetic-anhydride bath, stored in desiccator for a few days before experiment.

test_solution.preparation: Analytical-grade reagents; deaerated with purified N2. Deaeration duration, solvent grade and numerical pH are not supplied.

test_method.procedure_description: Tacussel PRT 20–2–M potentiostat; Pyrex glass cell at 25 °C, platinum counter electrode, SCE via Luggin capillary. Potentials were measured against SCE and reported by the authors on NHE scale; locked potentials remain as supplied. NaCl anodic polarization: 10 mV steps, waiting at each point for stationary current; no fixed numerical hold time. Figure 5 activity markers are retained without sampling fitted equations/lines.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Critical potential where a marked current increase begins and pits are detected on the surface; no single numerical current-density threshold is specified.

experiments.result_note: Approximate reading of the explicitly labeled Ep level. Figure 5 summarizes these critical-potential measurements; its corresponding 0.1 M point is retained as another location. Analytical Cu percentages and Al purity are used without inferring percent basis or calculating Al balance. The HClO4 electropolishing bath, pure-metal grain-boundary model compositions and air-saturated cathodic-polarization tests are not the test electrolyte/bulk chemistry of this observation. No numerical pH, chloride concentration or scan rate is calculated.

test_method.procedure_description: Tacussel PRT 20–2–M potentiostat; Pyrex glass cell at 25 °C, platinum counter electrode, SCE via Luggin capillary. Potentials were measured against SCE and reported by the authors on NHE scale; locked potentials remain as supplied. Figure 3 switches between −0.55 and −0.51 V NHE every 10–20 min, repeatedly on the same specimen; the caption reports the pitting potential separately. test_method.pitting_criterion: Caption-reported critical pitting potential; switching to the pitting range produces ≥2-order current increase and surface pits, returning to the passive range stops pitting. No single hold duration is imposed on the 10–20 min schedule.

experiments.result_note: Caption-reported pitting potential. The switched −0.51/−0.55 V levels are experimental controls, not additional onset measurements. Figure 5 supplies another presentation of the 1 M result. Analytical Cu percentages and Al purity are used without inferring percent basis or calculating Al balance. The HClO4 electropolishing bath, pure-metal grain-boundary model compositions and air-saturated cathodic-polarization tests are not the test electrolyte/bulk chemistry of this observation. No numerical pH, chloride concentration or scan rate is calculated.

test_method.procedure_description: Tacussel PRT 20–2–M potentiostat; Pyrex glass cell at 25 °C, platinum counter electrode, SCE via Luggin capillary. Potentials were measured against SCE and reported by the authors on NHE scale; locked potentials remain as supplied. Separate specimens held at various constant potentials for 5 h in 1 M NaCl (Figure 4). No pitting from −0.76 through −0.53 V NHE, current after 5 h below 1 µA/cm²; at the next tested level −0.52 V NHE the current rises by >3 orders and pitting commences.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Five-hour experimental onset bracket: no pitting at −0.53 V and pitting at −0.52 V NHE; retains strict/inclusive bound qualification from registry, not an exact scan onset.

experiments.result_note: Experimental onset bracket: no pitting at −0.53 V after 5 h, whereas pitting commenced at the higher −0.52 V level identified in Fig. 4. Thus the tested threshold is >−0.53 and ≤−0.52 V. This distinct current-time criterion is not merged with obs_002; a relationship to the same underlying specimens is unspecified. Analytical Cu percentages and Al purity are used without inferring percent basis or calculating Al balance. The HClO4 electropolishing bath, pure-metal grain-boundary model compositions and air-saturated cathodic-polarization tests are not the test electrolyte/bulk chemistry of this observation. No numerical pH, chloride concentration or scan rate is calculated.

alloy.microstructure: Solubilized single-phase Al–4%Cu; used to simulate grain bodies of the aged alloy.

test_method.procedure_description: Tacussel PRT 20–2–M potentiostat; Pyrex glass cell at 25 °C, platinum counter electrode, SCE via Luggin capillary. Potentials were measured against SCE and reported by the authors on NHE scale; locked potentials remain as supplied. Table 2 polarization curves in the stated non-NaCl electrolyte; individual increments/holds are not restated for these tests.
test_method.pitting_criterion: No pitting observed up to the highest applied +3.0 V NHE; strict lower limit on Epit, not pitting at the limit.

experiments.result_note: Source reports Epit > +3.0 V NHE: no pitting up to the highest applied potential; strict lower bound, not pitting at +3.0 V. Analytical Cu percentages and Al purity are used without inferring percent basis or calculating Al balance. The HClO4 electropolishing bath, pure-metal grain-boundary model compositions and air-saturated cathodic-polarization tests are not the test electrolyte/bulk chemistry of this observation. No numerical pH, chloride concentration or scan rate is calculated.

alloy.preparation: Pure 99.99% Al specimens; annealed for 2 h at 600 °C and water quenched. Coupons 10 × 30 mm cut from 1 mm cold-rolled sheet; edges and surface covered with cured epoxy leaving about 1 cm². Electropolished in HClO4/acetic-anhydride bath, stored in desiccator for a few days before experiment.
